hypothesis: Over-abstention on answerable questions comes from the high sampling share of '확인 불가' real-QA targets.
change: Only the real-QA abstention sampling share: 31.3% -> 10% of real QA (25.0% -> 8.0% of all training steps). Same parent (trid-public-dialogue-01), seed, steps 1200, lr, batch, L40S CUDA; validation byte-identical to mix-02.

heldout_public_qa.notes: Off-topic self-description, wrong facts, one repetition loop to the token limit.

conclusion: Hypothesis rejected. Cutting abstention targets by two thirds did not reduce answerable abstention (38.6% -> 41.2%); answerable accuracy did not improve (10.5% -> 7.5%, within noise for 228 items). Abstention is a fallback when the model fails to locate the answer, concentrated on long KLUE Wikipedia/news passages, not a learned frequency prior. Caveat: both runs start from trid-public-dialogue-01, which abstained on 93% of answerable questions.
review: Automatic RAG310 scoring; public 8 by assistant review against predeclared facts, not independent human evaluation.
